Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained. The mdw, the University of Music and Performing Arts in Vienna and the main public institution in the field, was read at source: its 25 departments include the Max Reinhardt Seminar for drama and the film academy, but no department of figure theatre or puppetry. The only Austrian offerings found belong to private bodies outside the denominator. A trap avoided along the way: the Figurentheater-Kolleg, which search engines return on an Austrian query, is in Bochum, Germany, and has nothing to do with this country. Upper bound raised from 0 to 1: the universities of Graz and Linz were not checked.

DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90. To be redone in full once the denominator is settled.
